question: Can a causal dynamic or automatic stop manager repair the negative expectancy of the frozen BTCUSDT.P 15m two-stage K1-to-K2 entry cohort, and which failure paths can each manager actually affect?

owner_authorization.verbatim: 继续下一步？动态止损，或者自动止损啊，不会去试试？详细分析失败的原因
owner_authorization.scope: research-only comparison of dynamic stop and automatic exit policies on the frozen pre-holdout 15m cohort

source.aggregation: complete UTC-aligned groups of three contiguous 5m rows

signal_and_entry_frozen.cohort: the predecessor two-stage K2 accepted decision ledger, filtered to the registered development window with a complete 48-bar path
signal_and_entry_frozen.signal: K1 crosses SMA40(HL2); K2 is the earliest valid touch-to-confirm interval of zero to two bars
signal_and_entry_frozen.entry: open immediately after the completed confirmation bar
signal_and_entry_frozen.risk_unit: absolute distance from next open to the original structure stop
signal_and_entry_frozen.cooldown_and_selection: already frozen in the predecessor causal decision ledger

execution_frozen.gap_policy: scheduled market exits fill at the next bar open; barrier exits fill at the barrier price
execution_frozen.baseline_profit_protection_stop: entry price plus direction times the 0.20 percent round-trip cost

factor.name: stop_manager_policy
factor.single_variable_claim: Every arm receives the identical frozen entry, original risk unit, 3R target, 48-bar horizon and cost; only the causal stop/exit state machine changes.

arms.label: baseline_close_fee_cover_1p5r
arms.rule: Use the original structure stop. If a completed close reaches 1.5R, move the following bar stop to fee cover.

arms.label: wick_r_ladder
arms.trigger_source: running favourable intrabar high or low, observed only after the bar completes
arms.rule: The stop is monotone and never below the original structure stop for a long or above it for a short.

arms.label: close_r_ladder
arms.rule: The stop is monotone and uses no current-bar stop update.

arms.label: atr_chandelier_1p5
arms.rule: After activation, trail the completed-bar favourable high-water mark by 1.5 times that completed bar's ATR14, floored at fee cover and made monotone.

arms.label: sma40_close_invalidation
arms.rule: Preserve the baseline stop and fee-cover protection. If a surviving completed candle closes on the wrong side of SMA40(HL2), schedule a market exit at the next bar open.

arms.label: soft_structure_reclaim_0p25atr
arms.rule: Before fee-cover protection activates, replace the original hard structure stop with a catastrophe barrier 0.25 confirmation-ATR farther away. A touch of the original stop may continue only when that bar closes back inside the original stop and on the intended SMA40 side; otherwise exit at the next open. The original risk unit, 3R target and position-risk accounting are not rescaled, so losses may exceed 1R.

development_gate.selection_tie_break: higher robust score, then higher worst fold, then higher mean net, then lexical label
development_gate.failure_action: retain baseline for comparison only, keep audit and repository holdout closed, and do not modify TradingView or production state

multiple_comparison.method: paired sign-flip max statistic across all five candidate-minus-baseline per-trade mean improvements

baseline_path_buckets: wick reached at least 1.5R without close-based protection
stop_bar_classes: wick crossed original stop but close reclaimed stop and intended SMA40 side
failure_diagnostics.counterfactual_warning: Any recovery after the baseline exit and any oracle rescue ceiling are post-exit diagnostics, not causal trading rules.
failure_diagnostics.early_failure_label: baseline stop with realised pre-exit MFE below 0.5R

causal_classifier.purpose: test whether entry-time features can identify early failures; never select a policy or mutate the strategy
models: L2 logistic regression with StandardScaler, C=1, balanced class weights
depth-2 decision tree with minimum leaf 10 and balanced class weights

chart_contract.question: Which stop policy changes net expectancy and robustness?
chart_contract.palette: single blue root plus open fills and neutral zero line

chart_contract.question: Where does the baseline loss come from and which policies alter each path?
chart_contract.palette: blue and orange roots with direct labels

chart_contract.question: Are policy effects stable across chronological halves?

audit_gate.holdout_action: never read the repository holdout without new configuration-specific owner authorization
